intro.text: The Transport Certificate is used for mutual TLS (mTLS) to authenticate your application when making API requests to LFIs.
All API calls you make as a TPP must present this certificate. Without it, LFI endpoints will reject the connection before any request is processed.

blocks.text: Follow the Keys & Certificates guide to generate your private key and CSR, then upload the CSR to the Trust Framework to receive your certificate.
When selecting the certificate type during generation, choose Transport.
